# gatsby-parcel-config

A minimal Parcel config for use in Gatsby. See [Parcel default config](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@parcel/config-default).

This vendored copy preserves Gatsby's `gatsby-parcel-config@1.16.0` package, but removes Parcel's dev-server reporter from the config and dependency list because this site does not need that reporter for Gatsby builds.
